name: Infrastructure, Commodities & Corporate Power
description: Railways, canals, energy, food, communications, industrial systems, corporations, and the material networks that reshape political power.
subjects: the construction of national power grids
promptContext: Show how a material system changed capacity, incentives, geography, and political leverage. Explain what the infrastructure or corporation actually enabled, who financed and controlled it, and who bore its costs; avoid treating technology as an autonomous force outside institutions and choices.
